SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

-- ===== A0 =====
SET @q := 'MC246530';

SET @q_digits := REGEXP_REPLACE(@q, '[^0-9]', '');

SET @dot := (
    SELECT dot_number FROM (
        -- MC / FF / MX docket number
        SELECT a.dot_number, 1 AS rank_order
        FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a
        WHERE @q_digits <> ''
          AND a.docket_number IN (CONCAT('MC', @q_digits), CONCAT('FF', @q_digits), CONCAT('MX', @q_digits))

        UNION ALL

        -- Bare DOT number
        SELECT c.dot_number, 2
        FROM carrier.carriers c
        WHERE @q_digits <> '' AND c.dot_number = CAST(@q_digits AS UNSIGNED)

        UNION ALL

        -- Email address
        SELECT c.dot_number, 3
        FROM carrier.carriers c
        WHERE @q LIKE '%@%' AND c.email_address = @q

        UNION ALL

        -- Exact legal name / DBA
        SELECT c.dot_number, 4
        FROM carrier.carriers c
        WHERE @q NOT LIKE '%@%' AND @q_digits = ''
          AND (c.legal_name = @q OR c.dba_name = @q)
    ) m
    ORDER BY rank_order
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT @dot AS resolved_dot;   -- NULL or >1 plausible match => fall through to A3

-- ===== A1 =====
SET @dot := 1749;

WITH auth AS (
    SELECT
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.docket_number ORDER BY a.docket_number SEPARATOR ', ') AS docket_numbers,
        MAX(a.common_stat)                                                     AS common_stat,
        MAX(a.contract_stat)                                                   AS contract_stat,
        MAX(a.broker_stat)                                                     AS broker_stat,
        MAX(a.common_stat = 'A' OR a.contract_stat = 'A' OR a.broker_stat = 'A') AS has_active_authority,
        MAX(a.broker_stat = 'A')                                               AS has_broker_authority,
        MAX(a.common_stat = 'A' OR a.contract_stat = 'A')                      AS has_carrier_authority,
        MAX(CAST(NULLIF(a.min_cov_amount, '') AS UNSIGNED))                    AS bipd_required_k
    FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a
    WHERE a.dot_number = @dot
),
-- Current coverage comes from the FMCSA ACTPENDINS file, not
-- insurance_filings: the latter is the *history* file (only ~6.4k of its 7.4M
-- rows are uncancelled), so reading it for "insurance on file" reports almost
-- every carrier as uninsured. actpendinsur_all_with_history is keyed on
-- dot_int (the integer DOT); mod_col_1 carries the coverage type.
filings AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        (f.mod_col_1 LIKE 'BIPD%')                                             AS is_bipd,
        (f.mod_col_1 = 'CARGO')                                                AS is_cargo,
        (f.mod_col_1 IN ('SURETY', 'TRUST FUND'))                              AS is_bond,
        (f.cancl_effective_date IS NULL OR f.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())  AS is_live
    FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history f
    WHERE f.dot_int = @dot
),
ins AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_bipd  AND is_live THEN max_cov_amount END)            AS bipd_on_file_k,
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_cargo AND is_live THEN max_cov_amount END)            AS cargo_on_file_k,
        MAX(is_cargo AND is_live)                                              AS cargo_on_file,
        MAX(is_bond  AND is_live)                                              AS bond_on_file,
        MAX(cancl_effective_date IS NOT NULL
            AND cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())                              AS pending_cancellation,
        MIN(CASE WHEN cancl_effective_date > CURDATE()
                 THEN cancl_effective_date END)                                AS cancels_on,
        COUNT(*)                                                               AS filing_count
    FROM filings
),
bipd_current AS (   -- the specific filing behind the limit above
    SELECT name_company, policy_no, effective_date, cancl_effective_date, max_cov_amount
    FROM filings
    WHERE is_bipd AND is_live
    ORDER BY max_cov_amount DESC, effective_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
orders AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)                                                               AS authority_order_count,
        SUM(order2_effective_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 36 MONTH)             AS revocations_36mo
    FROM carrier.carrier_authority_orders
    WHERE dot_number = @dot
),
oos AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL)                        AS active_oos_orders,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL THEN oos_reason END) AS active_oos_reason,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL THEN oos_date   END) AS active_oos_date
    FROM carrier.carrier_oos_orders
    WHERE dot_number = @dot
),
activity AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.inspections
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND insp_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AS inspections_12mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND fatalities > 0)                             AS fatal_crashes,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND report_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH) AS crashes_24mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_contacts WHERE dot_number = @dot)   AS boc3_filings
),
benchmark AS (   -- national vehicle OOS rate, same definition CarrierRiskService caches
    -- ~2.7s of this query's ~3.4s: an unindexed scan of 690k sms_measures rows
    -- for a number that moves monthly. CarrierRiskService caches it for an
    -- hour; for interactive use substitute the cached value instead:
    --     SELECT 0.2494 AS natl_vehicle_oos
    SELECT AVG(vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(vehicle_insp_total, 0)) AS natl_vehicle_oos
    FROM carrier.sms_measures
    WHERE vehicle_insp_total >= 5
)
SELECT
    -- ---- verdict (GR-9: the gate is stated before anything else) ----
    CASE
        WHEN d.status_code <> 'A'                                    THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN auth.has_active_authority = 0                           THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN oos.active_oos_orders > 0                               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN d.safety_rating IN ('U', 'C')                           THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN orders.revocations_36mo > 0                             THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NULL                              THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k < auth.bipd_required_k               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) < 90                    THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.pending_cancellation = 1                            THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN ins.cargo_on_file = 0                                   THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN auth.has_broker_authority = 1
             AND auth.has_carrier_authority = 1                      THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN activity.boc3_filings = 0                               THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN c.mcs150_date < CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH           THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN activity.fatal_crashes > 0                              THEN 'REVIEW'
        ELSE 'PASS'
    END                                                                       AS verdict,
    CONCAT_WS('; ',
        CASE WHEN d.status_code <> 'A'                      THEN CONCAT('USDOT registration ', d.status_code) END,
        CASE WHEN auth.has_active_authority = 0             THEN 'no active operating authority' END,
        CASE WHEN oos.active_oos_orders > 0                 THEN CONCAT('federal out-of-service order ', oos.active_oos_date, ' (', oos.active_oos_reason, ')') END,
        CASE WHEN d.safety_rating IN ('U','C')              THEN CONCAT(IF(d.safety_rating='U','Unsatisfactory','Conditional'), ' safety rating') END,
        CASE WHEN orders.revocations_36mo > 0               THEN CONCAT(orders.revocations_36mo, ' revocation(s) in last 36 months') END,
        CASE WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NULL                THEN 'no active BIPD insurance on file' END,
        CASE WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k < auth.bipd_required_k THEN 'liability coverage below federal minimum' END,
        CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) < 90      THEN CONCAT('authority only ', DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date), ' days old') END,
        CASE WHEN ins.pending_cancellation = 1              THEN 'insurance cancellation pending' END,
        CASE WHEN ins.cargo_on_file = 0                     THEN 'no cargo insurance on file' END,
        CASE WHEN auth.has_broker_authority = 1 AND auth.has_carrier_authority = 1 THEN 'holds both carrier and broker authority (double-broker risk)' END,
        CASE WHEN activity.boc3_filings = 0                 THEN 'no BOC-3 process agent on file' END,
        CASE WHEN c.mcs150_date < CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH THEN 'MCS-150 filing overdue' END,
        CASE WHEN activity.fatal_crashes > 0                THEN CONCAT(activity.fatal_crashes, ' fatal crash(es) on record') END
    )                                                                         AS verdict_reasons,

    -- ---- identity ----
    c.dot_number,
    auth.docket_numbers                                                       AS mc_numbers,
    c.legal_name,
    c.dba_name,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', c.phy_city, c.phy_state)                                  AS based_in,

    -- ---- authority ----
    auth.common_stat, auth.contract_stat, auth.broker_stat,
    d.status_code                                                             AS usdot_status,
    CASE c.carrier_operation
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Interstate'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Intrastate Hazmat'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Intrastate Non-Hazmat'
        ELSE c.carrier_operation END                                          AS operation_type,
    c.add_date                                                                AS authority_granted,
    ROUND(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) / 365.25, 1)                        AS years_active,
    COALESCE(orders.revocations_36mo, 0)                                      AS revocations_last_36mo,
    IF(COALESCE(orders.authority_order_count, 0) = 0 AND auth.has_active_authority = 1,
       'uninterrupted', 'interrupted')                                        AS authority_history,

    -- ---- insurance on file ----
    ins.bipd_on_file_k  * 1000                                                AS bipd_limit_usd,
    auth.bipd_required_k * 1000                                               AS bipd_required_usd,
    ins.cargo_on_file_k * 1000                                                AS cargo_limit_usd,
    bc.name_company                                                           AS bipd_insurer,
    bc.policy_no                                                              AS bipd_policy_no,
    bc.effective_date                                                         AS bipd_effective_date,
    bc.cancl_effective_date                                                   AS bipd_cancels_on,
    IF(ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NOT NULL, 'active', 'none on file')              AS bipd_state,
    COALESCE(ins.bond_on_file, 0)                                             AS surety_bond_on_file,
    COALESCE(ins.pending_cancellation, 0)                                     AS pending_cancellation,
    ins.cancels_on                                                            AS next_cancellation_date,

    -- ---- safety ----
    CASE d.safety_rating
        WHEN 'S' THEN 'Satisfactory'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Conditional'
        WHEN 'U' THEN 'Unsatisfactory'
        ELSE 'Not rated' END                                                  AS safety_rating,
    d.safety_rating_date,
    sms.insp_total                                                            AS inspections_total,
    ROUND(100 * sms.driver_oos_insp_total  / NULLIF(sms.driver_insp_total, 0), 1)  AS driver_oos_pct,
    ROUND(100 * sms.vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(sms.vehicle_insp_total, 0), 1) AS vehicle_oos_pct,
    ROUND(100 * b.natl_vehicle_oos, 1)                                        AS natl_vehicle_oos_pct,
    activity.inspections_12mo,
    activity.crashes_24mo,
    activity.fatal_crashes,

    -- ---- fleet ----
    c.nbr_power_unit                                                          AS power_units,
    c.driver_total                                                            AS drivers,

    -- ---- freshness (GR: every answer carries a stamp) ----
    GREATEST(COALESCE(c.updated_at, '1970-01-01'),
             COALESCE(d.updated_at, '1970-01-01'))                            AS fmcsa_synced_at
FROM carrier.carriers c
CROSS JOIN auth
CROSS JOIN ins
CROSS JOIN orders
CROSS JOIN oos
CROSS JOIN activity
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
LEFT JOIN bipd_current bc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d ON d.dot_number = c.dot_number
LEFT JOIN carrier.sms_measures   sms ON sms.dot_number = c.dot_number
WHERE c.dot_number = @dot;

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.inspections i

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes cr

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.telephone = c.telephone AND o.telephone <> '' AND o.dot_number <> c.dot_number) AS shared_phone,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.email_address = c.email_address AND o.email_address <> '' AND o.dot_number <> c.dot_number) AS shared_email,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.phy_state = c.phy_state AND o.phy_city = c.phy_city

           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS bipd_k,

        (SELECT MAX(i.cancl_effective_date IS NOT NULL AND i.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())
           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS pending_cancel,
        (SELECT AVG(vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(vehicle_insp_total,0))
           FROM carrier.sms_measures WHERE vehicle_insp_total >= 5)                AS natl_veh_oos
    FROM carrier.carriers c
    LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d  ON d.dot_number  = c.dot_number
    LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_census  ce ON ce.dot_number = c.dot_number
    LEFT JOIN carrier.sms_measures   sms ON sms.dot_number = c.dot_number

),
factors AS (

    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'Holds active operating authority',          has_active_authority = 1 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'Authorized for hire',                       authorized_for_hire = 1 FROM f   -- NULL when the census file has no row yet
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'No federal out-of-service order',           active_oos = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'No revocations in last 36 months',          revocations_36mo = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'MCS-150 filing current (< 24 months)',      mcs150_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'BOC-3 process agent on file',               boc3 > 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Active BIPD insurance on file',             bipd_k IS NOT NULL FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Liability coverage meets federal minimum',  bipd_k >= bipd_required_k FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Cargo insurance on file',                   cargo_live = 1 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'No pending insurance cancellation',         COALESCE(pending_cancel, 0) = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'Safety rating not Unsatisfactory/Conditional',
                                  IF(safety_rating IS NULL OR safety_rating = '', NULL, safety_rating NOT IN ('U','C')) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'No acute/critical violations',

SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

-- ===== A3 =====
SET @name := 'RUNDLETT';

SELECT
    c.dot_number,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.docket_number ORDER BY a.docket_number SEPARATOR ', ')
       FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number) AS mc_numbers,
    c.legal_name,
    c.dba_name,
    c.phy_state,
    c.phy_city,
    CONCAT_WS('/',
        NULLIF(CONCAT('Common:',  (SELECT MAX(common_stat)   FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)), 'Common:'),
        NULLIF(CONCAT('Contract:',(SELECT MAX(contract_stat) FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)), 'Contract:'),
        NULLIF(CONCAT('Broker:',  (SELECT MAX(broker_stat)   FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)), 'Broker:')
    )                                                                        AS authority,

    c.nbr_power_unit                                                         AS power_units
FROM carrier.carriers c
LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d ON d.dot_number = c.dot_number
WHERE c.legal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name, '%')
   OR c.dba_name   LIKE CONCAT('%', @name, '%')
ORDER BY (d.status_code = 'A') DESC, c.nbr_power_unit DESC
LIMIT 25;

-- ===== A0 =====
SET @q := 'MC246530';

SET @q_digits := REGEXP_REPLACE(@q, '[^0-9]', '');

SET @dot := (
    SELECT dot_number FROM (
        -- MC / FF / MX docket number
        SELECT a.dot_number, 1 AS rank_order
        FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a
        WHERE @q_digits <> ''
          AND a.docket_number IN (CONCAT('MC', @q_digits), CONCAT('FF', @q_digits), CONCAT('MX', @q_digits))

        UNION ALL

        -- Bare DOT number
        SELECT c.dot_number, 2
        FROM carrier.carriers c
        WHERE @q_digits <> '' AND c.dot_number = CAST(@q_digits AS UNSIGNED)

        UNION ALL

        -- Email address

        FROM carrier.carriers c
        WHERE @q LIKE '%@%' AND c.email_address = @q

        UNION ALL

        -- Exact legal name / DBA

        FROM carrier.carriers c

    ) m
    ORDER BY rank_order
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT @dot AS resolved_dot;   -- NULL or >1 plausible match => fall through to A3

-- ===== A1 =====
SET @dot := 1749;

WITH auth AS (
    SELECT
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.docket_number ORDER BY a.docket_number SEPARATOR ', ') AS docket_numbers,
        MAX(a.common_stat)                                                     AS common_stat,
        MAX(a.contract_stat)                                                   AS contract_stat,
        MAX(a.broker_stat)                                                     AS broker_stat,
        MAX(a.common_stat = 'A' OR a.contract_stat = 'A' OR a.broker_stat = 'A') AS has_active_authority,
        MAX(a.broker_stat = 'A')                                               AS has_broker_authority,
        MAX(a.common_stat = 'A' OR a.contract_stat = 'A')                      AS has_carrier_authority,
        MAX(CAST(NULLIF(a.min_cov_amount, '') AS UNSIGNED))                    AS bipd_required_k
    FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a
    WHERE a.dot_number = @dot
),
-- Current coverage comes from the FMCSA ACTPENDINS file, not
-- insurance_filings: the latter is the *history* file (only ~6.4k of its 7.4M
-- rows are uncancelled), so reading it for "insurance on file" reports almost
-- every carrier as uninsured. actpendinsur_all_with_history is keyed on
-- dot_int (the integer DOT); mod_col_1 carries the coverage type.
filings AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        (f.mod_col_1 LIKE 'BIPD%')                                             AS is_bipd,
        (f.mod_col_1 = 'CARGO')                                                AS is_cargo,
        (f.mod_col_1 IN ('SURETY', 'TRUST FUND'))                              AS is_bond,
        (f.cancl_effective_date IS NULL OR f.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())  AS is_live
    FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history f
    WHERE f.dot_int = @dot
),
ins AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_bipd  AND is_live THEN max_cov_amount END)            AS bipd_on_file_k,
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_cargo AND is_live THEN max_cov_amount END)            AS cargo_on_file_k,
        MAX(is_cargo AND is_live)                                              AS cargo_on_file,
        MAX(is_bond  AND is_live)                                              AS bond_on_file,
        MAX(cancl_effective_date IS NOT NULL
            AND cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())                              AS pending_cancellation,
        MIN(CASE WHEN cancl_effective_date > CURDATE()
                 THEN cancl_effective_date END)                                AS cancels_on,
        COUNT(*)                                                               AS filing_count
    FROM filings
),
bipd_current AS (   -- the specific filing behind the limit above
    SELECT name_company, policy_no, effective_date, cancl_effective_date, max_cov_amount
    FROM filings
    WHERE is_bipd AND is_live
    ORDER BY max_cov_amount DESC, effective_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
orders AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)                                                               AS authority_order_count,
        SUM(order2_effective_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 36 MONTH)             AS revocations_36mo
    FROM carrier.carrier_authority_orders
    WHERE dot_number = @dot
),
oos AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL)                        AS active_oos_orders,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL THEN oos_reason END) AS active_oos_reason,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND rescind_date IS NULL THEN oos_date   END) AS active_oos_date
    FROM carrier.carrier_oos_orders
    WHERE dot_number = @dot
),
activity AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.inspections
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND insp_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AS inspections_12mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND fatalities > 0)                             AS fatal_crashes,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes
          WHERE dot_number = @dot AND report_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH) AS crashes_24mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_contacts WHERE dot_number = @dot)   AS boc3_filings
),
benchmark AS (   -- national vehicle OOS rate, same definition CarrierRiskService caches
    -- ~2.7s of this query's ~3.4s: an unindexed scan of 690k sms_measures rows
    -- for a number that moves monthly. CarrierRiskService caches it for an
    -- hour; for interactive use substitute the cached value instead:
    --     SELECT 0.2494 AS natl_vehicle_oos
    SELECT AVG(vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(vehicle_insp_total, 0)) AS natl_vehicle_oos
    FROM carrier.sms_measures
    WHERE vehicle_insp_total >= 5
)
SELECT
    -- ---- verdict (GR-9: the gate is stated before anything else) ----
    CASE
        WHEN d.status_code <> 'A'                                    THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN auth.has_active_authority = 0                           THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN oos.active_oos_orders > 0                               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN d.safety_rating IN ('U', 'C')                           THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN orders.revocations_36mo > 0                             THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NULL                              THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k < auth.bipd_required_k               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) < 90                    THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN ins.pending_cancellation = 1                            THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN ins.cargo_on_file = 0                                   THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN auth.has_broker_authority = 1
             AND auth.has_carrier_authority = 1                      THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN activity.boc3_filings = 0                               THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN c.mcs150_date < CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH           THEN 'REVIEW'
        WHEN activity.fatal_crashes > 0                              THEN 'REVIEW'
        ELSE 'PASS'
    END                                                                       AS verdict,
    CONCAT_WS('; ',
        CASE WHEN d.status_code <> 'A'                      THEN CONCAT('USDOT registration ', d.status_code) END,
        CASE WHEN auth.has_active_authority = 0             THEN 'no active operating authority' END,
        CASE WHEN oos.active_oos_orders > 0                 THEN CONCAT('federal out-of-service order ', oos.active_oos_date, ' (', oos.active_oos_reason, ')') END,
        CASE WHEN d.safety_rating IN ('U','C')              THEN CONCAT(IF(d.safety_rating='U','Unsatisfactory','Conditional'), ' safety rating') END,
        CASE WHEN orders.revocations_36mo > 0               THEN CONCAT(orders.revocations_36mo, ' revocation(s) in last 36 months') END,
        CASE WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NULL                THEN 'no active BIPD insurance on file' END,
        CASE WHEN ins.bipd_on_file_k < auth.bipd_required_k THEN 'liability coverage below federal minimum' END,
        CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) < 90      THEN CONCAT('authority only ', DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date), ' days old') END,
        CASE WHEN ins.pending_cancellation = 1              THEN 'insurance cancellation pending' END,
        CASE WHEN ins.cargo_on_file = 0                     THEN 'no cargo insurance on file' END,
        CASE WHEN auth.has_broker_authority = 1 AND auth.has_carrier_authority = 1 THEN 'holds both carrier and broker authority (double-broker risk)' END,
        CASE WHEN activity.boc3_filings = 0                 THEN 'no BOC-3 process agent on file' END,
        CASE WHEN c.mcs150_date < CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH THEN 'MCS-150 filing overdue' END,
        CASE WHEN activity.fatal_crashes > 0                THEN CONCAT(activity.fatal_crashes, ' fatal crash(es) on record') END
    )                                                                         AS verdict_reasons,

    -- ---- identity ----
    c.dot_number,
    auth.docket_numbers                                                       AS mc_numbers,
    c.legal_name,
    c.dba_name,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', c.phy_city, c.phy_state)                                  AS based_in,

    -- ---- authority ----
    auth.common_stat, auth.contract_stat, auth.broker_stat,
    d.status_code                                                             AS usdot_status,
    CASE c.carrier_operation
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Interstate'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Intrastate Hazmat'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Intrastate Non-Hazmat'
        ELSE c.carrier_operation END                                          AS operation_type,
    c.add_date                                                                AS authority_granted,
    ROUND(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.add_date) / 365.25, 1)                        AS years_active,
    COALESCE(orders.revocations_36mo, 0)                                      AS revocations_last_36mo,
    IF(COALESCE(orders.authority_order_count, 0) = 0 AND auth.has_active_authority = 1,
       'uninterrupted', 'interrupted')                                        AS authority_history,

    -- ---- insurance on file ----
    ins.bipd_on_file_k  * 1000                                                AS bipd_limit_usd,
    auth.bipd_required_k * 1000                                               AS bipd_required_usd,
    ins.cargo_on_file_k * 1000                                                AS cargo_limit_usd,
    bc.name_company                                                           AS bipd_insurer,
    bc.policy_no                                                              AS bipd_policy_no,
    bc.effective_date                                                         AS bipd_effective_date,
    bc.cancl_effective_date                                                   AS bipd_cancels_on,
    IF(ins.bipd_on_file_k IS NOT NULL, 'active', 'none on file')              AS bipd_state,
    COALESCE(ins.bond_on_file, 0)                                             AS surety_bond_on_file,
    COALESCE(ins.pending_cancellation, 0)                                     AS pending_cancellation,
    ins.cancels_on                                                            AS next_cancellation_date,

    -- ---- safety ----
    CASE d.safety_rating
        WHEN 'S' THEN 'Satisfactory'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Conditional'
        WHEN 'U' THEN 'Unsatisfactory'
        ELSE 'Not rated' END                                                  AS safety_rating,
    d.safety_rating_date,
    sms.insp_total                                                            AS inspections_total,
    ROUND(100 * sms.driver_oos_insp_total  / NULLIF(sms.driver_insp_total, 0), 1)  AS driver_oos_pct,
    ROUND(100 * sms.vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(sms.vehicle_insp_total, 0), 1) AS vehicle_oos_pct,
    ROUND(100 * b.natl_vehicle_oos, 1)                                        AS natl_vehicle_oos_pct,
    activity.inspections_12mo,
    activity.crashes_24mo,
    activity.fatal_crashes,

    -- ---- fleet ----
    c.nbr_power_unit                                                          AS power_units,
    c.driver_total                                                            AS drivers,

    -- ---- freshness (GR: every answer carries a stamp) ----
    GREATEST(COALESCE(c.updated_at, '1970-01-01'),
             COALESCE(d.updated_at, '1970-01-01'))                            AS fmcsa_synced_at
FROM carrier.carriers c
CROSS JOIN auth
CROSS JOIN ins
CROSS JOIN orders
CROSS JOIN oos
CROSS JOIN activity
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
LEFT JOIN bipd_current bc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d ON d.dot_number = c.dot_number
LEFT JOIN carrier.sms_measures   sms ON sms.dot_number = c.dot_number
WHERE c.dot_number = @dot;

-- ===== A1b =====
SET @dot := 1749;

WITH f AS (
    SELECT
        c.dot_number,
        c.telephone, c.email_address, c.phy_street, c.phy_city, c.phy_state,
        c.add_date, c.mcs150_date,
        d.status_code, d.safety_rating, d.dun_bradstreet_no,
        sms.insp_total, sms.vehicle_insp_total, sms.vehicle_oos_insp_total,
        sms.unsafe_driv_ac, sms.hos_driv_ac, sms.driv_fit_ac, sms.contr_subst_ac, sms.veh_maint_ac,
        (SELECT MAX(a.common_stat='A' OR a.contract_stat='A' OR a.broker_stat='A')
           FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)   AS has_active_authority,
        (SELECT MAX(CAST(NULLIF(a.min_cov_amount,'') AS UNSIGNED))
           FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)   AS bipd_required_k,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_oos_orders o
           WHERE o.dot_number = c.dot_number AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.rescind_date IS NULL) AS active_oos,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_authority_orders o
           WHERE o.dot_number = c.dot_number
             AND o.order2_effective_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 36 MONTH)          AS revocations_36mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_contacts x WHERE x.dot_number = c.dot_number) AS boc3,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.inspections i
           WHERE i.dot_number = c.dot_number AND i.insp_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AS insp_12mo,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.crashes cr
           WHERE cr.dot_number = c.dot_number AND cr.fatalities > 0)               AS fatal_crashes,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.telephone = c.telephone AND o.telephone <> '' AND o.dot_number <> c.dot_number) AS shared_phone,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.email_address = c.email_address AND o.email_address <> '' AND o.dot_number <> c.dot_number) AS shared_email,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carriers o
           WHERE o.phy_state = c.phy_state AND o.phy_city = c.phy_city
             AND o.phy_street = c.phy_street AND o.dot_number <> c.dot_number)     AS shared_address,
        ce.authorized_for_hire,
        (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.mod_col_1 LIKE 'BIPD%'
                          AND (i.cancl_effective_date IS NULL OR i.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())
                    THEN i.max_cov_amount END)
           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS bipd_k,
        (SELECT MAX(i.mod_col_1 = 'CARGO'
                    AND (i.cancl_effective_date IS NULL OR i.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE()))
           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS cargo_live,
        (SELECT MAX(i.cancl_effective_date IS NOT NULL AND i.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())
           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS pending_cancel,
        (SELECT AVG(vehicle_oos_insp_total / NULLIF(vehicle_insp_total,0))
           FROM carrier.sms_measures WHERE vehicle_insp_total >= 5)                AS natl_veh_oos
    FROM carrier.carriers c
    LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d  ON d.dot_number  = c.dot_number
    LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_census  ce ON ce.dot_number = c.dot_number
    LEFT JOIN carrier.sms_measures   sms ON sms.dot_number = c.dot_number
    WHERE c.dot_number = @dot
),
factors AS (
    SELECT 'authority'  AS category, 'Active USDOT registration'              AS factor, status_code = 'A' AS passed FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'Holds active operating authority',          has_active_authority = 1 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'Authorized for hire',                       authorized_for_hire = 1 FROM f   -- NULL when the census file has no row yet
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'No federal out-of-service order',           active_oos = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'No revocations in last 36 months',          revocations_36mo = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'MCS-150 filing current (< 24 months)',      mcs150_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'authority', 'BOC-3 process agent on file',               boc3 > 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Active BIPD insurance on file',             bipd_k IS NOT NULL FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Liability coverage meets federal minimum',  bipd_k >= bipd_required_k FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'Cargo insurance on file',                   cargo_live = 1 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'insurance', 'No pending insurance cancellation',         COALESCE(pending_cancel, 0) = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'Safety rating not Unsatisfactory/Conditional',
                                  IF(safety_rating IS NULL OR safety_rating = '', NULL, safety_rating NOT IN ('U','C')) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'No acute/critical violations',
                                  IF(insp_total IS NULL, NULL,
                                     COALESCE(unsafe_driv_ac,0) + COALESCE(hos_driv_ac,0) + COALESCE(driv_fit_ac,0)
                                   + COALESCE(contr_subst_ac,0) + COALESCE(veh_maint_ac,0) = 0) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'No fatal crashes on record',                fatal_crashes = 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'Vehicle OOS rate below industry average',
                                  IF(vehicle_insp_total >= 5,
                                     (vehicle_oos_insp_total / vehicle_insp_total) < natl_veh_oos, NULL) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'safety',    'Inspection activity in last 12 months',     insp_12mo > 0 FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'identity',  'Phone unique to this carrier',
                                  IF(telephone IS NULL OR telephone = '', NULL, shared_phone = 0) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'identity',  'Email unique to this carrier',
                                  IF(email_address IS NULL OR email_address = '', NULL, shared_email = 0) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'identity',  'Address unique to this carrier',
                                  IF(CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(COALESCE(phy_street,''))) <= 5, NULL, shared_address = 0) FROM f
    UNION ALL SELECT 'identity',  'Address verified as non-virtual',
                                  UPPER(COALESCE(phy_street,'')) NOT REGEXP
                                  'UPS STORE|REGUS|WEWORK|PMB |POSTAL ANNEX|MAIL BOXES ETC|MAILBOX|REGISTERED AGENT|VIRTUAL OFFICE|SUITE #' FROM f
)
SELECT
    category,
    factor,
    CASE passed WHEN 1 THEN 'pass' WHEN 0 THEN 'fail' ELSE 'monitoring' END AS state,
    -- the "n/20" line, carried on every row so one query answers both
    SUM(passed = 1)     OVER () AS factors_passed,
    SUM(passed = 0)     OVER () AS factors_failed,
    SUM(passed IS NULL) OVER () AS factors_monitoring,
    COUNT(*)            OVER () AS factors_total
FROM factors
ORDER BY FIELD(category, 'authority', 'insurance', 'safety', 'identity'),
         passed IS NULL, passed, factor;

SET @mc_list := 'MC246530,MC1246530';   -- or set @dot_list directly

WITH wanted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.dot_number
    FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a
    WHERE FIND_IN_SET(a.docket_number, @mc_list)
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.dot_number,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.docket_number SEPARATOR ', ')
           FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)   AS mc_numbers,
        c.legal_name,
        d.status_code,
        d.safety_rating,
        c.add_date,
        (SELECT MAX(a.common_stat='A' OR a.contract_stat='A' OR a.broker_stat='A')
           FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)   AS has_active_authority,
        (SELECT MAX(CAST(NULLIF(a.min_cov_amount,'') AS UNSIGNED))
           FROM carrier.carrier_authorities a WHERE a.dot_number = c.dot_number)   AS bipd_required_k,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_oos_orders o
          WHERE o.dot_number = c.dot_number AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.rescind_date IS NULL) AS active_oos,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carrier.carrier_authority_orders o
          WHERE o.dot_number = c.dot_number
            AND o.order2_effective_date > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 36 MONTH)           AS revocations_36mo,
        (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.mod_col_1 LIKE 'BIPD%'
                          AND (i.cancl_effective_date IS NULL OR i.cancl_effective_date > CURDATE())
                    THEN i.max_cov_amount END)
           FROM carrier.actpendinsur_all_with_history i WHERE i.dot_int = c.dot_number) AS bipd_k
    FROM carrier.carriers c
    JOIN wanted w ON w.dot_number = c.dot_number
    LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details d ON d.dot_number = c.dot_number
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN status_code <> 'A'                     THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN has_active_authority = 0               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN active_oos > 0                         THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN safety_rating IN ('U','C')             THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN revocations_36mo > 0                   THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN bipd_k IS NULL                         THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN bipd_k < bipd_required_k               THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), add_date) < 90     THEN 'HARD-STOP'
        ELSE 'REVIEW / PASS — run A1 for the full gate'
    END                                             AS verdict,
    mc_numbers, dot_number, legal_name, status_code, safety_rating,
    bipd_k * 1000                                   AS bipd_limit_usd,
    revocations_36mo, active_oos,
    ROUND(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), add_date) / 365.25, 1) AS years_active
FROM scored
ORDER BY verdict = 'HARD-STOP' DESC, legal_name;

answer_shape: Legal name <-> DBA mapping from the record. B6b puts both names side by side: same DOT on both rows means same entity.

SET NAMES utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

-- ===== B6 =====
SET @dot := 1749;

SELECT
    c.dot_number,
    c.legal_name,
    c.dba_name,
    a.legal_name                                                          AS legal_name_on_authority,
    a.dba_name                                                            AS dba_name_on_authority,
    a.docket_number,
    d.business_org_desc                                                   AS entity_type
FROM carrier.carriers c
LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_authorities a ON a.dot_number = c.dot_number
LEFT JOIN carrier.carrier_details     d ON d.dot_number = c.dot_number
WHERE c.dot_number = @dot;

-- B6b — "is <name> the same entity as <other name>?" Both names, side by side,
-- with the DOT that carries each. Same DOT on both rows => same entity.
SET @name_a := 'WARRIOR TRUCKING';
SET @name_b := 'SIKANDER S GILL';

SELECT
    IF(c.legal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_a, '%') OR c.dba_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_a, '%'),
       @name_a, @name_b)        AS matched_on,
    c.dot_number, c.legal_name, c.dba_name, c.phy_city, c.phy_state
FROM carrier.carriers c
WHERE c.legal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_a, '%') OR c.dba_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_a, '%')
   OR c.legal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_b, '%') OR c.dba_name LIKE CONCAT('%', @name_b, '%')
LIMIT 25;
